items.t: Where Tripadvisor Goes After A 51% Drop
items.sum: Tripadvisor’s sale of TheFork to American Express for US$700 million, roughly half of Tripadvisor’s market value at announcement, looked like the kind of catalyst that could reset the story. Holding Tripadvisor over the past year would have meant a 50.9% loss, including dividends. items.t: Bear of the Day: Tripadvisor, Inc. (TRIP)
items.sum: TRIP's earnings outlook has tumbled over the past year as AI disruptions continue to dent Tripadvisor's traffic. Its downbeat earnings revisions picture lands it a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) right now.

items.t: Why Did SOC, OPEN, TRIP Stocks Plunge To 52-Week Lows Today?
